alt: 一位成人面對入門圖解教材仍滿臉茫然，老師耐心指著種子生長的簡單圖片。
scene_prompt: In an adult learning room, a well-dressed but uninformed adult looks completely baffled by an elementary illustrated learning book open before them, scratching their head with blank confused eyes. A patient tutor points to a very simple drawing of a seed growing into a plant while the adult cannot explain it; unused books lie closed beside them. The person is awake and trying but lacks basic learning. No chest marks or spilled ink, no mocking crowd, absolutely no letters or numerals on pages.
